title: ReasonAgain: Using Extractable Symbolic Programs to Evaluate Mathematical Reasoning

live_model.evidence: "We evaluate 4 LLMs in this paper: GPT-4-Turbo (OpenAI et al., 2024), GPT-4o ..., LLama-3.1-8B ..., and Qwen-2.5-7B ... using ... direct, few-shot CoT, and CoT+SC" (Sec. 3.1)

prompt.location: Section 3.1: Direct prompt printed verbatim; CoT uses the 8-shot template of Wei et al. (2022)

claim.metric: exact-match accuracy, Direct, GSM8K original questions ('Before')
claim.location: Table 1, row GPT4-Turbo / Direct, GSM8K Accu. Before

data.source: GSM8K and MATH public; the 1121/268 filtered cases and 5 GPT-4o-generated perturbations per case are in github.com/CogComp/reasoning-eval (contents unverified)

notes: 'After' numbers need the released perturbations. Version not printed; resolved by date rule (Oct 2024).

resolution.plan: The 1,121 GSM8K cases are the subset whose GPT-4o-extracted program reproduces the gold answer; take the released case list from the repository, run the printed Direct prompt with gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0 and compute exact match vs Table 1 (45.43). Without the repository, run the full GSM8K test set (1,319) and compare at set level.
resolution.approximation: Direct-setting temperature assumed 0 (stated only for CoT); the fallback uses the full test set instead of the filtered 1,121.
